rom.name: Baseball Stars - Pocket Sports Series (Japan, Europe) (En,Ja).ngp

input: work/standalone/tools/sdlfeed.c (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES into the ad-hoc-signed Homebrew binary): SDL key events synthesized inside the process on presented frames, from the retro-run script mapped to Mednafen's default keys (gen_sdlfeed.py); F9 snapshot for shot, F10 reset, F12 exit (Mednafen writes saves on exit)

layout.name: <ROM file name without extension>.<game MD5 as Mednafen computes it>.<ext> (filesys.fname_sav %f.%M%x)

note: NeoPop-format flash file (7208 bytes: block list of the written flash ranges, not a raw 2 Mbit image), the same format and size as beetle-neopop's <stem>.flash. A first run with NGP A/B swapped in the key map never reached GAME OPTION (536-byte file, not filed).
